subject.name: AP European History
subject.cedVersion: AP European History CED (Course Framework V.1, (c)2026; 2027 exam: fully digital, 55 MC/55 min, 3 SAQ/40 min, DBQ 60 min incl. 15 min reading + LEQ 40 min)
subject.designNotes: 9 units (c. 1450 to present), each weighted 10-15% on MC, with topic codes and class periods from the posted CED (read 2026-10-20). Exam: fully digital; Section I Part A 55 MC, 55 min, 40%; Part B 3 SAQ, 40 min, 20% (secondary source, primary source, non-text source); Section II DBQ 25% (60 min recommended incl. 15 min reading, 7 documents) and LEQ 15% (40 min). AP Central announces updated SAQ/LEQ question formats starting May 2027 without changing course content or section timing; the specific new SAQ/LEQ formats were not described on the pages read and should be rechecked in the AP History Exam Updates. Skills are the history skills 1.A-6.D (same codes and wording as the AP U.S. and World History files). Topic titles for 2.6, 3.3/3.4, 4.7, 6.8, 7.4, 9.10 and a few others are close paraphrases of truncated CED text. Per-topic and per-sub-keyword skills are an ALTON editorial mapping (one skill per sub-keyword chosen by kind and content), not the CED's per-topic suggested skills. Sub-keywords, kinds, requires and estLessons are ALTON editorial designs, not CED content. Topic titles are the CED's where read from the CED course-at-a-glance; where the extracted text was truncated they are close paraphrases.
